decisions.reason: The source decision is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY establishing that the master site has no booking system and sibling location sites host bookings.
Assigning bookings to sibling sites does not change the existing requirement that visitors select a location on the master site and are routed to its separate Wix site.
The source relies on the existing standalone-site architecture but does not change the requirement that each location uses a separate Wix website and account.
The allocation of booking handling between the master and sibling sites does not change the reusable template strategy for future location sites.
The booking-system decision does not alter the competitor-referenced layout, visual style, navigation style, or design scope.
The source changes booking responsibility, not the Smash Room brand name or its application across sites.
Moving booking handling to sibling sites does not change the requirement to retain the same packages and prices across reused location-site formats.
The source identifies where bookings occur but does not change the existing separate payment setups or payout handling for individual locations.
Having sibling sites handle bookings is consistent with, but does not modify, the existing isolation of bookings, calendars, revenue, sales, and reporting by location.
The master-site booking decision does not alter the Bay Area SEO-preservation requirement.
